data.gender_notes: Oran is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Oran is recorded in name-lists as “Mountain man”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Oran expresses “Mountain man”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Oran total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: אורן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Oran is derived from the Hebrew word 'or' which means 'light'. The suffix 'an' is added to form a personal name, resulting in the meaning 'light, torch'.

in_greek.name: Ὀράνης
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Oran in Greek is derived from the word 'oros' meaning 'mountain' and 'ana' meaning 'up'. The name can be interpreted as 'mountain of light'.

in_latin.name: Oranus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Oranus is derived from the Greek name Oranios, which is a Latinization of the Greek name Ὀράνης. The name can be interpreted as 'mountain of light'.
